note: Media Audio is a glue submodule of Lightning Media: one hook_media_source_info_alter() calling Override::pluginClass($sources['audio_file'], AudioFile::class), where AudioFile extends core's audio_file source and mixes in FileInputExtensionMatchTrait to implement InputMatchInterface. It has no routes, permissions, services, settings form (configure = null), config schema, Drush commands or plugin types. Everything else is config/optional: media.type.audio (source audio_file, source field field_media_audio_file, default extensions 'mp3 wav aac'), field_media_in_library, and default/media_library/embedded/thumbnail displays. All cases are grounded in that exact configuration.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal module lightning_media_audio actually add to a site, and which media source plugin and source field does its media type use?
evals.expected_output: It installs an Audio media type (media.type.audio) that uses core's audio_file media source with the source field field_media_audio_file (default allowed extensions mp3 wav aac), plus a field_media_in_library instance and default/media_library/embedded/thumbnail displays. The only code is a hook_media_source_info_alter() that swaps in an input-matching subclass of the source plugin.

evals.prompt: How does lightning_media_audio make Drupal recognise that an uploaded file belongs to the Audio media type, and which trait implements that?
evals.expected_output: Drupal\lightning_media_audio\Plugin\media\Source\AudioFile extends core's AudioFile source, implements Drupal\lightning_media\InputMatchInterface and uses Drupal\lightning_media\FileInputExtensionMatchTrait, whose appliesTo() compares the uploaded file's extension against the source field's file_extensions setting. lightning_media_audio_media_source_info_alter() swaps the class in with Override::pluginClass().

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with lightning_media_audio, editors need to upload FLAC files but the upload is rejected. Which configuration do I change, and does the module have a settings page for it?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page (configure is null). Edit the Audio media type's source field field_media_audio_file and add flac to its 'Allowed file extensions' setting - config field.field.media.audio.field_media_audio_file, key settings.file_extensions (default 'mp3 wav aac').

evals.prompt: Inspect the live configuration of this Drupal site and tell me exactly which file extensions the Audio media type currently accepts for upload, and which field that setting lives on.
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.audio.field_media_audio_file has settings.file_extensions set to 'mp3 wav aac flac opus', so the Audio media type accepts mp3, wav, aac, flac and opus.

evals.prompt: A media type on this Drupal site is labelled 'LM Podcast Audio'. Inspect the running site and tell me its machine name, the media source plugin it uses, and the machine name of its source field.
evals.expected_output: Machine name audio, source plugin audio_file (the input-matching subclass installed by lightning_media_audio), source field field_media_audio_file.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Audio media type provided by lightning_media_audio currently only accepts mp3, wav and aac uploads. Change the live configuration so that it also accepts m4a and ogg files, keeping the existing three formats.
evals.expected_output: field.field.media.audio.field_media_audio_file settings.file_extensions contains mp3, wav, aac, m4a and ogg (e.g. 'mp3 wav aac m4a ogg').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an Audio media item named 'LM Audio Task' whose source field references a real file entity. It is a working file, so it must NOT appear in the media library - use the field Lightning Media adds for that.
evals.expected_output: A media entity of bundle 'audio' named 'LM Audio Task' whose field_media_audio_file references a saved File entity and whose field_media_in_library is FALSE.
